overall: Substantial local development components complete; current integrated acceptance remains open, formal benchmark not ready. Do not mark every T00-T14 complete.
scope_boundary: Root actively adding model-action evidence, controller dependency preflight and real judge reruns. Snapshot below does not pre-judge unfinished work; supersede with new immutable evidence.

T00.sufficient_evidence: Real CPU/container limit, isolation and lifecycle diagnostics; export/load and captured-byte hash rejection tested.
T00.remaining: Publish timeout artifact-loss/checkpoint policy and exercise declared failure lifecycle. No kernel-escape proof or cross-host identity required to close local pilot.

T01.sufficient_evidence: Fresh subscribed CLI calls, fixed role/model, exact rollout rejection and costs implemented.
T01.remaining: Choose and document formal executor service: genuine API or explicitly Codex-JSON service with fixed native overhead. Do not market bare-model equivalence.

T02.sufficient_evidence: Real MCP evidence reads, pixel delivery case and single-turn score/feedback demonstrated.
T02.remaining: Revalidate new evidence publication and latest policy on actual tasks; retain observed judge failures.

T03.sufficient_evidence: Positive/negative calibration has differentiation; repeat IDEA varies 3.4/3.6.
T03.remaining: Root actively repairing attribution/evidence; finish each real task trajectory review and small untouched acceptance set after prompt freeze.

T04.sufficient_evidence: Same published budget checked against broker/session, absolute deadline, OOM/PID/scratch tests and ledger.
T04.remaining: Current 4-call WRITE_EVIDENCE cap constrains generated single-tool-per-call H0 below natural minimum read/write/run/view/final. Validate per-task feasible budgets before interpreting quality.

T05.sufficient_evidence: CPU read/write/run and judge actual image smoke exist; R2 service is connected in code.
T05.remaining: Need actual current-version LIT retrieval/read and WRITE evidence artifact/pixel chain or independent non-scientific complete feasibility chain.

T06.sufficient_evidence: Typed failure helper and stored raw platform failures exist.
T06.remaining: Run-specific attribution must feed judge and aggregation; old LIT provider failure scored 0, WE material_failure and IV solver errors need evidence-based adjudication. No silent exclusion or automatic zeros.

T07.sufficient_evidence: H0 released zero scientific tasks; only approved MCP used; worker mount/capability budgets tested.
T07.remaining: Residual native schemas require finite allowed/denied action+canary tests or dedicated role execution boundary. Flags/no observed misuse insufficient; absolute security proof not required.

T08.sufficient_evidence: 18 pinned original documents, cross-package and date/alias/version filters tested.
T08.remaining: Two neighborhoods and partial earliest-disclosure audit remain; verify target early disclosure and cross-split target exclusion before formal tasks.

T09.sufficient_evidence: Returned/read/adopted diagnostics exist and intended private roles maintained.
T09.remaining: Audit relevance labels on several real queries; freeze diagnostic formulas and keep outside primary score unless user confirms.

T10.sufficient_evidence: IV independent pass_with_pending_runtime; SSA minor patch root-approved, explicit sources/output/budgets.
T10.remaining: Do not extrapolate scientific material validity to LIT/IDEA or formal pool; per-package semantic audit remains needed.

T11.sufficient_evidence: Two concurrent Luna packages and independent sol reviews, immutable revisions, actual cost/disk captured.
T11.remaining: Luna revisions introduced new science errors; maintainer corrections not autonomous pass. Compare a small fresh-paper batch/alternative explicitly approved constructor before scaling.

T12.sufficient_evidence: Frozen generated H0 repaired with public ABI-only feedback; 17 self tests plus 6 independent tests and reviewed tool trajectory.
T12.remaining: No scientific success or formal isolation claim; frozen H0 changes must be versioned rather than maintainer patched.

T13.sufficient_evidence: Five stage executions exist; WRITE_CONTENT completed/scored4; others include model, artifact, evidence and budget issues.
T13.remaining: Finish root current repairs/new judges, inspect every executor and judge trajectory, assign failures, verify feasible budgets. H0 need not succeed on every task, but platform/material confounds must be resolved.

T14.remaining: No accepted mixed task pool/split/frozen configs or actual builder-evolution-to-native-judge-to-selection orchestration acceptance. Formal parameters require user approval.

important_actionable_gaps.action: Complete repaired evidence_for_run wiring (all public model actions, harness-local error distinction, trusted provider status/resource timing). Rejudge preserved actual outputs under frozen updated judge policy and review each complete action/feedback trace.
important_actionable_gaps.acceptance: Provider/controller failure -> infrastructure/unassessable rather than agent zero; missing solver artifact with available inputs -> agent/partial; unsupported material blame rejected; healthy content stays high if justified.
important_actionable_gaps.avoid: Do not demand all H0 task scores high; honest low score is valid.

important_actionable_gaps.action: Publish bounded per-task feasibility estimates and run a minimal complete WRITE_EVIDENCE delivery chain under a new explicit pilot budget; retain old runs. Review EXP headroom separately.
important_actionable_gaps.evidence: H0 one action per model call; WE 4-call budget allows at most3 tools plusfinal, while read data/write code/run/view/final generally needs>=5. Old WE used4model/3tool in50.4s; IV used6model in277s of1200s.
important_actionable_gaps.acceptance: A permitted implementation can complete required artifacts and inspection within the selected budget; budget remains equal across compared harnesses and frozen before formal evaluation.
important_actionable_gaps.avoid: Do not tune formal task budget from hidden-test success or force a universal budget.

important_actionable_gaps.action: Decide fixed Codex-JSON executor service vs genuine API. Pin full instructions/tool surface/binary; reject forbidden execution, add a finite host-read/write/network/canary negative test suite or isolate role process.
important_actionable_gaps.acceptance: Observed required model-only JSON calls and images pass, forbidden routes blocked or response/run rejected with no private access; exact scope disclosed.
important_actionable_gaps.avoid: No demand to prove subscription CLI identical to raw API or defeat arbitrary kernel exploits.

important_actionable_gaps.action: Freeze repaired construction template, run small fresh-paper construction/review batch before mass production, preserving first-pass and revision failures separately from controller fixes.
important_actionable_gaps.acceptance: Report independently source-verified accepted yield/cost across more than two repeatedly inspected papers, CPU viability and per-stage coverage.
important_actionable_gaps.avoid: No autonomous-quality claim from maintainer-corrected output; do not spend all remaining calls chasing pass on same papers.

important_actionable_gaps.action: Separate judge development fixtures from a new small untouched acceptance set across real papers and natural defects; run at least paired equivalent/order/repeat and semantic-feedback canary checks.
important_actionable_gaps.acceptance: Predefined rubric behavior and attribution checks pass after prompt freeze; observed sensitivities reported.
important_actionable_gaps.avoid: Not expert human grading, not arbitrary score depression, not a claim that a few cases statistically certify reliability.

important_actionable_gaps.action: Wire bounded real builder/evolver to EvolutionRun and current container/native-judge outputs. Demonstrate one mixed-search round and immutable H0/H1 snapshots, public-only feedback, builder selection before hidden evaluator results, cost join and resume. Use synthetic/nonformal manifests first.
important_actionable_gaps.acceptance: Actual executable harness edit and native evaluation flow complete with no private-test content in evolver inputs; formal main scale remains separate.
important_actionable_gaps.avoid: Offline controller unit tests or ABI-only H0 repair do not establish self-improvement pipeline.

important_actionable_gaps.action: Complete source first-disclosure and target-alias exclusion audit, private relevance/coverage review, rights disposition and paper-level split; propose accepted pool size/repetitions/rounds/error denominator for user approval.
important_actionable_gaps.acceptance: Frozen versioned inputs, sufficient accepted mixed-stage coverage, declared sampling bias and formal dataset not the two-paper development set.
important_actionable_gaps.avoid: No need to fully recover historical idea/failed-research trajectories or prove global novelty.

important_actionable_gaps.action: Choose and test bounded checkpoint capture or explicitly document uncheckpointed tmpfs loss at timeout; freeze/quiesce artifacts for capture and keep controller/hash observations distinct from worker claims.
important_actionable_gaps.acceptance: One real deadline/provider-timeout scenario preserves declared logs/cost/checkpoints and attributes loss correctly; captured hash mismatch rejected.
important_actionable_gaps.avoid: Do not require recovery of every arbitrary intermediate byte or cross-host bitwise scientific determinism.

reasonable_development_close_condition: G1 current evidence+judge attribution, G2 feasible task budget, and G8 declared failure behavior have bounded evidence; consolidated acceptance report states which components pass and which formal gates remain pending. If goal literally includes formal T14, it cannot honestly be completed at this local pilot boundary.
not_blockers_for_local_pilot: No clean-host/server migration until user chooses full-scale host
No TTS attribution analysis before primary pipeline
No requirement that weak H0 solves all research tasks
reporting_cautions: Input tokens include cached tokens; subscription transport counts exclude interactive collaboration cost.
Two-papers frequently debugged are development only; statistical ranking/generalization claims unsupported.
A schema-valid submission or containers running is not completed scientific research.
No independent complete audit of every new global file claimed; evidence reviewed is enumerated.
